purpose: Source-authored contracts for custom law profiles that require forward movement or committed kill semantics. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.
requiredRuntimeProof: battle board coordinate before action proof
battle board coordinate after action proof
forward direction relative to opposing side proof
negative status application target correlation proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: any movement counted as forward movement
attack action counted as forward movement without coordinate delta proof
kill preview or lethal damage estimate counted as committed kill
damage event counted as kill without victim death proof
negative status predicate counted as forward movement or kill
Stronghold faction membership counted as forward pressure trigger
stronghold.forward-move-kill-armor-press.notes: Warband Crush requires either proven forward movement relative to the opposing side or a committed kill by the acting stack. Static battle-action surfaces can prepare diagnostics only; gameplay still requires coordinates, direction, kill commit, target correlation, and idempotence proof.
